## D2-05 · NEW in a DELETE trigger

> **GENERATED · written for this system (reinforces a concept from the source)**  
> Source: [lecture3 L1603-1608](../sources/lecture3.txt) *“you get access to this keyword called old”*

| Topic / concepts | Difficulty | Skills | Dataset | Task type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C2.9 | ★★ |  | `mfa` | change the database |

This trigger is supposed to log sales. SQLite creates it without complaint, but now every DELETE on collections fails. Fix the trigger.

<details><summary>Setup</summary>

```sql
CREATE TABLE "transactions" ("id" INTEGER, "title" TEXT, "action" TEXT, PRIMARY KEY("id"));
```
</details>

```sql
CREATE TRIGGER "sell" BEFORE DELETE ON "collections"
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO "transactions" ("title", "action") VALUES (NEW."title", 'sold');
END;
```

<details><summary>Bug type</summary>

`trigger`
</details>

Hints → [`hints/M2.md`](../hints/M2.md#d2-05) · Fix → [`solutions/M2.md`](../solutions/M2.md#d2-05)
